recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, 1970s-style portrait composition featuring a central framed photograph of a smiling man against a deep orange-red gradient, surrounded by a wide peach-colored border with tight, high-contrast serif typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The central portrait is enclosed by a thin white and green double-line frame.
The typography is anchored to the top right, partially overlapping the outer border and the inner frame.
The warm color palette creates a monochromatic harmony between the subject's clothing, the background, and the outer border.
coreInvariants: A wide, solid-color outer margin acting as a secondary frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered in the inner frame, shown from the chest up with one arm raised to the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white shirt collar act as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the raised arm upward to the typography in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space is provided by the wide peach-colored outer border.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep burnt orange and mahogany (inner background)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark brown (typography) and mint green (thin frame line)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the outer border contrasting with high saturation and deep shadows in the central photograph.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines

typesetting.case: Mixed (All-caps for name, Title case for title)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different sizes and cases to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, sharp-serif aesthetic of the 70s.
Captures the vintage weight and feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s-style studio portrait of a man with a warm smile and a raised arm, wearing a cream-colored shirt. The background should be a gradient of burnt orange to dark mahogany. Place this image inside a thin double-line frame (white and mint green) centered on a wide peach-colored solid background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the top right corner using a high-contrast bold serif font. The first line should be in all-caps, and the second block should be smaller title-case text stacked vertically. The letters must be dark brown and set with extremely tight tracking so they nearly touch.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm earth tones?
Does the typography have high stroke contrast?
Is the tracking tight enough that characters almost touch?
Is the central image framed by a wide border?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is dark brown, not black.
Check that the green frame line is a muted mint shade.
Verify the subject's shirt has a vintage 70s collar style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned studio portrait with a wide solid-color margin and high-contrast, tightly-spaced serif typography anchored to a corner.
